description: This file defines the Drupal.Message class and related functions for managing user messages in a Drupal-based web application, including message creation, display, removal, and accessibility features.

classes.name: Drupal.Message
classes.description: Class providing methods to add, remove, select, and manage messages within a specified DOM element, including accessibility support.

methods.name: Drupal.Message.defaultWrapper
methods.description: Determines or creates the default message container element in the DOM.

methods.name: Drupal.Message.getMessageTypeLabels
methods.description: Returns an object mapping message types to their labels.

methods.name: Drupal.Message.add
methods.description: Adds a message to the message area, with support for message types, IDs, and screen reader announcements.

methods.name: Drupal.Message.select
methods.description: Selects a message element by its ID.

methods.name: Drupal.Message.remove
methods.description: Removes a message element by its ID.

methods.name: Drupal.Message.clear
methods.description: Removes all messages from the message area.

methods.name: Drupal.Message.announce
methods.description: Helper method to send messages to screen readers with appropriate priority.

methods.name: Drupal.Message.messageInternalWrapper
methods.description: Creates an internal wrapper element for messages.
